copy.h1: Powerball in Florida: Results, Local Features and Claim Information
copy.localPurpose: Powerball is a multi-state game. The drawing is the same everywhere; what changes by state is how you buy, how long you have to claim, and where you claim. This page covers the Florida side of it.
